title: Transition showcase
premise: The same action carries you between locations. Every cut is a match on movement — the reel that is entirely about the edit.

shots.what: The first location, with the exit move already starting
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Stand still for a second, then whip the camera hard left. The whip must be fast enough to blur — a slow one reads as a mistake.

shots.what: Second location, entering on a whip from the same direction
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Whip *into* the shot from the same side you whipped out of. Direction must match or the cut fights itself — this is the one rule the whole blueprint rests on.

shots.what: Third location, same action — a step, a turn, a hand across the lens
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Pick one action and repeat it identically everywhere. Same speed, same direction, same distance from the lens.

shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Vary the place, never the move. The consistency is what sells it.

shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Widen here to give the sequence somewhere to go before the payoff.

shots.what: The best location of the set, arriving and then holding still
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Whip in as before, then stop dead and hold four seconds. After five fast cuts, stillness is the payoff.

shots.what: Back to location one, matching the opening frame
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Same framing as shot 1 so it loops. Hold four seconds for the text.
